english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for comprehending words, facts, or what someone means, including understanding someone's feelings or intentions.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for comprehending or understanding something.

exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ge3 ji3 si1

english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for understanding or grasping an idea.

exampleSentences.english: I now apprehend why you made that choice.
exampleSentences.traditional: 而家我明白你點解作出呢個選擇喇。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 dim2 gaai2 zok3 ceot1 ni1 go3 syun2 zaak6 laa3

english.note: Use this when get means understand an idea, explanation, or joke.

exampleSentences.english: I get why you did that.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 dim2 gaai2 gam2 zou6

english.note: Use this for understanding and sympathizing with someone's feelings or point of view, as in 我明白你.

exampleSentences.english: I hear you; I understand why you are so angry.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 dim2 gaai2 gam3 nau1

english.note: Use this when appreciate means understanding or being fully aware of a situation or its importance.

exampleSentences.english: I appreciate how much pressure you’re under right now.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我明白你而家有幾大壓力。
exampleSentences.jyutping: ngo5 ming4 baak6 nei5 ji4 gaa1 jau5 gei2 daai6 aat3 lik6

english.note: Use this when “follow me” means understand what I am saying.

exampleSentences.english: Do you follow what I’m saying?
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 ming4 baak6 ngo5 gong2 gan2 mat1 maa3
